narrative.details:
Remy mentioned murlocs the other day... I'm pretty sure he hates the little buggers as much as I do.

He might have some ideas on how to keep them away from my fish in the future. I'd like to ask you to go chat with him and see if there's anything he can think of.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Remy "Two Times" about Jason's murloc problems.
narrative.offerRewardText: I've been warning the guards about the murlocs. They won't listen.I have a few ideas on how to get back at those critters. I'll need your help getting what I need for it though.
